4.
Membership  of  Institution  of  Building  Services
Engineering  and  Technology  of  Sri  Lanka  (IBSE  &  TSL)
shall be open to persons who are practicing in any discipline
of Building Services Engineering and Technology, such as
in  the  disciplines  of  design,  installation,  maintenance,
manufacture or supply of products and services associated
with a building. The members of the Institution shall be such
persons as the Institution would admit to membership.
